name: Toilet
scene: A two-piece toilet against the bathroom wall on a tiled floor: bowl with seat and lid, tank on the back with its walls built separately so the inside shows when the lid comes off, water in the tank and bowl, supply valve on the wall low on the left with a braided supply line up to the tank.
size: Bowl rim at 0.38-0.43 m, tank 0.45-0.52 m wide, 0.18-0.23 m deep, 0.33-0.40 m tall sitting on the back of the bowl; overall about 0.75-0.8 m tall and 0.7 m deep.

parts.label: Tank lid
parts.describe: Heavy ceramic lid on top of the tank; lift up and set aside.

parts.label: Flush handle
parts.describe: Chrome trip lever on the front-left of the tank with a lift arm inside reaching to the middle; build the arm as its child.

parts.label: Flapper
parts.describe: Red or black rubber seal on the flush valve at the tank bottom centre, hinged at the back to the overflow tube.

parts.label: Flapper chain
parts.describe: Thin chain from the lift arm down to the flapper with a little slack.

parts.label: Fill valve
parts.describe: Tall plastic tower on the left inside the tank with a float cup on it and a cap on top.

parts.label: Float
parts.describe: Float cup on the fill valve tower (or a float ball on an arm on older valves); slides up and down to set the water level.

parts.label: Fill valve cap
parts.describe: Cap on top of the fill valve that twists off to flush debris out.

parts.label: Overflow tube
parts.describe: Open vertical tube behind the flapper, its top a little above the water line.

parts.label: Refill tube
parts.describe: Small black tube from the fill valve clipped into the overflow tube.

parts.label: Water shutoff valve
parts.describe: Oval or round handle on a chrome valve on the wall low on the left, normally open; turn clockwise to close.

parts.label: Supply line
parts.describe: Braided steel hose from the valve up to the tank bottom.

parts.label: Flapper seat buildup
parts.describe: Mineral scale on the flush valve seat under the flapper.

parts.label: Toilet lid
parts.describe: Seat cover hinged at the back.

parts.label: Bowl
parts.describe: Ceramic bowl (lathe with z stretch 1.3) with water in it.

debris: mineral scale on the flapper seat
a clog (clump) in the bowl outlet
views: from above into the open tank
low front-left for the shutoff valve
notes: Tank origin at its outside bottom centre makes the internals easy to place. Water level sits 2-3 cm below the overflow top.
